::: {.why}
The gap you measured last night is the price of trading with someone who knew something, and decomposing the spread this way is the standard framework for the next two weeks.
:::

## What you should be able to do tonight

- Decompose the effective spread into realized spread and price impact, and report both for one symbol.
- Say what each component compensates the liquidity provider for.

## Tasks <span class='task-total'>60 min</span>

::: {.task-list}
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [35 min]{.task-min} Complete the decomposition: effective spread equals realized spread plus price impact, where impact is the permanent move in the mid after the trade. Report all three for one symbol, in basis points, and check the identity holds. Then split by trade size and note that the impact component grows with size while the realized spread does not.
:::
::: {.task}
<input type="checkbox" class="task-check"> [25 min]{.task-min} Interpret the two parts: the realized spread is what the market maker actually keeps and covers their processing and inventory costs, and the impact is what they lose to informed flow. A market where the realized spread is near zero is one where making markets is a technology business rather than a risk business.
:::
:::
